dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, Mr. Brown. It's my part-time job. I work here on the weekend.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn. ɪts maɪ ˌpɑːrt taɪm ˈdʒɑːb. aɪ ˈwɜːrk ˈhɪr ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I usually serve customers. But today I'm working in the kitchen.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈsɜːrv ˈkʌstəmərz. bʌt təˈdeɪ aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, eight hours. Look, a lot of customers are waiting!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz. ˈlʊk, ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈkʌstəmərz ər ˈweɪtɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I don't earn a lot, but I love it.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɜːrn ə ˈlɑːt, bʌt aɪ ˈlʌv ɪt.
